capabilities: Run BM25, vector, and deep hybrid searches via the qmd CLI
Find notes similar to the active note or to selected text
Scope searches to specific folder prefixes with dedicated commands
Monitor index status and refresh documents or embeddings
Open, split, copy links for, or reveal results from search cards
extras: Requires installing the qmd CLI separately; desktop only and limited to macOS/Linux. Installed via BRAT or manual file copy, and the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search only does keyword matching, so semantic or embedding-based retrieval requires running a separate tool outside the vault.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that wraps the qmd CLI so you can run BM25 / vector / hybrid

summary: Search interface for the qmd CLI that adds BM25, vector, and hybrid semantic retrieval to the vault with scopes and result actions.
